Current view shows `test.py` open in VS Code with the bubble_sort function. The cursor is at line 1, col 1. We need to indent lines 2–10 by one tab. We'll jump to line 2, move to its start, extend selection down to line 10, then press Tab.

```python
import time
import pyautogui

# Go to line 2
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'g')
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.typewrite('2')
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.3)

# Ensure we're at start of line
pyautogui.press('home')
time.sleep(0.2)

# Select lines 2 through 10
for _ in range(8):
    pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'down')
    time.sleep(0.1)

# Indent selected lines
pyautogui.press('tab')
```
